target_customer: Retail investors in Latin America who want access to US stocks and crypto
problem: Latin American savers have limited and costly access to US equities and other assets, with high minimums and local currency risk.
business_model: Consumer investing app (revenue model not stated; sources mention no trading commissions and investing from 1 USD)

founders.name: Robert Baron
previous_startups: Part of more than five startups (names not given)
founders.background_notes: YC page bio: engineer with fintech experience, specialized in blockchain, fintech and software architecture.

founders.name: James Jara
founders.background_notes: YC page bio mentions an AI visibility agency and authorship of a book on nearshoring in LATAM.

technical_complexity.rationale: Brokerage and crypto access can be built on third party broker APIs, but a three person team still had to handle KYC, custody partners and multi-country compliance.

defensibility.rationale: Regional brokerage apps are replicable on the same broker APIs; no network effect or exclusive licence is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Multiple regional players added US stock access, with Bitso launching US stock trading in Mexico via Alpaca and Lemon in Argentina and Peru; no source shows Botin acquired.

market_need_then: Several Latin American apps were launching US stock access around 2021 to 2022, indicating demand, but no dated user numbers were found for Botin.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: The cause of Botin's inactive status is not public. No shutdown notice, layoff coverage or post-mortem was found, the website returned a 503 error, and the team was three people. Funding was small and the field of Latin American US stock apps was crowded, but no source ties either to the outcome, so no failure factor is assigned.
notes: Site returned HTTP 503 (site status unknown). Funding is weak: descubre.vc says a seed round with Caricaco as investor but gives no date or amount; Caricaco's Fondo Despegar chose Botin among six startups (observador.cr). The $100K Pareto Holdings Feb 2021 seed comes from an aggregator result and conflicts with another listing of a total of $100K pre-seed and a $130K YC seed in Aug 2022; which aggregator page showed which figure was not individually verified (Crunchbase, startup-seeker and roundfunded were all returned). Treat all amounts as unverified single-database data. Competitors left empty because the competitor sources found (Bitso, Lemon, Hapi) were dated 2026 or undated. Location conflicts across databases (Costa Rica, London, Wilmington).
